The '''Blaze''' was a [[Hoverbike/Legends|hoverbike]] produced by [[Longspur and Alloi]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
